Class ChatShellFactory

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.shell.ChatShellFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.sshd.server.shell.ShellFactory
@Component public class ChatShellFactory extends Object implements org.apache.sshd.server.shell.ShellFactory
The ChatShellFactory class builds one ChatShell for each SSH connection. That shell gets its own ChatSession and its own CommandProcessor. A refused login does not open stored chat memory for the user. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#ChatShellFactory

  • Constructor Details

    • ChatShellFactory

      public ChatShellFactory(CasseroleProperties properties, CommandProcessorFactory commandProcessorFactory, FormatRouterFactory formatRouterFactory, LlmService llmService, LlmRouter llmRouter, RouxChatMemory rouxMemory, Lamina lamina, AmwpFacade amwpFacade, @Value("${spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.model:qwen2.5-coder:7b}") String modelName)
      The constructor stores the settings, the factories, the model services, and the shared turn path. The model name is the configured chat model.
      Parameters:
      properties - The properties are the casserole settings.
      commandProcessorFactory - The command processor factory builds one command registry per session.
      formatRouterFactory - The format router factory builds the reply formatter.
      llmService - The language-model service is the Ollama boundary.
      llmRouter - The router is the map of language-model providers.
      rouxMemory - The memory is the stored chat memory.
      lamina - The lamina is the server thread model.
      amwpFacade - The facade is the shared path for a console turn and a cell turn.
      modelName - The model name is the configured chat model.

  • Method Details

    • createShell

      public org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command createShell(org.apache.sshd.server.channel.ChannelSession channel)
      The method builds the shell for one channel, or a RejectShell when the login cannot open memory. The username comes from the server session. A missing session or a read failure uses an empty name. RegionOwner.sanitize(String) rejects an illegal name with RejectShell and the text invalid username. Ram-only memory builds a ChatSession without opening a stored region. Any other memory opens the user. A refused open returns RejectShell with that reason. A failure while building the session closes the open and throws again. The method then builds a command processor and a format router. The router follows the smart-format setting. The return value is an AmwpAwareShell around the new ChatShell. A runtime failure prints its stack and throws again.
      Specified by:
      createShell in interface org.apache.sshd.server.shell.ShellFactory
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel that needs a shell.
      Returns:
      The return value is the shell command for that channel.
